name: Wildflower posy
description: Meadow flowers tied with twine, picked this morning.

name: Potted fern
description: A small fern in a clay pot, hard to kill.

name: Moss ball
description: A damp, velvety ball of pond moss in a dish.

name: Seed packets
description: Paper twists of herb and bean seed, labelled by hand.

name: Lavender soap
description: A pale cake of scented soap wrapped in linen.

name: Honey cakes
description: Three sticky cakes in a paper bag, still warm.

name: Candied plums
description: A small box of sugared plums.

name: Tin of loose-leaf tea
description: An upland black tea in a small painted tin.

name: Bag of coffee beans
description: Roasted this week by the people who supply Spell & Sip.

name: Bottle of spiced cider
description: Strong, sweet and best drunk in company.

name: Salt pretzels
description: Knotted bread crusted with coarse salt.

name: Ruled ledger
description: A hardback accounts book with ruled pages, for people who still think better on paper.

name: On Money and Credit
description: A much-argued classic of economics, in a battered student paperback.

name: Book of furrow hymns
description: A pocket book of the Order's hymns with a ribbon marker.

name: Pink sketchbook
description: Thick drawing paper between rose-coloured boards.

name: Old rail map of the Expanse
description: Out of date, beautifully drawn, slightly foxed. Two of the portal lines on it were never built.

name: Deck of cards
description: A worn deck. Possibly marked; the seller won't say.

name: Silk ribbon
description: A length of bright silk for hair or a wrist.

name: Lace choker
description: Fine black lace with a small silver clasp.

name: River stone
description: A smooth grey stone that holds the sun's warmth.

name: Whetstone
description: A fine-grained stone for keeping a competition blade honest.

name: Tooled duty belt
description: Sturdy leather with a plain brass buckle, made to carry a blade and a radio and to last.

name: Set of picks
description: Sold as 'ward-testing tools'. Nobody is fooled.

name: Glass vials
description: Six stoppered vials in a padded case, for careful potion-work.

name: Retro game cartridge
description: A classic for a console older than you are. The label is worn and the save file is someone else's.

name: Charm-circuit kit
description: A solder-it-yourself board that takes one small enchantment. The box says ages ten and up.

name: Refurbished earbuds
description: Good sound, one careful owner, a case with a scratch on it.

name: Warded phone case
description: A slim case with a drop-ward stitched into the lining. Rated for one flight of stairs.

name: Cup of Ember Ramen
description: The instant version of Cauldron's famous dish. Heats itself when you pull the tab, usually.

name: Can of Sparkroot
description: An energy drink in a can that hums slightly. Popular in exam season.

name: Lucky Seven scratchcard
description: Seven petals to scratch. The odds are printed on the back in small type.

name: Phone charger
description: A charger and cable, because everyone has lost theirs.

name: Lavender bath salts
description: A jar of scented salts for a long soak.

name: Box of chamomile tea
description: Twenty bags of something calming, from the shelf by the till.

name: Study tonic
description: A licensed focus tonic in a brown bottle. One before a lecture, never two.

name: Pocket speaker
description: A speaker the size of a plum that is louder than it has any right to be.

name: Game controller
description: A wireless controller in translucent purple.

name: Charm-light desk lamp
description: A desk lamp with a small light-charm in place of a bulb. Dims when you tell it to.

name: Quartz point
description: A clear crystal the length of a finger, sold for focusing small workings and bought mostly because it is pretty.

name: Pouch of spell components
description: Dried herbs, salts and powders in labelled twists, for potion-work and practicals.

name: Charm bracelet
description: A fine silver chain with one small luck-charm on it and room for more.

name: Tarot deck
description: Seventy-eight cards in a velvet bag. The Bloom is trump twenty-two.

name: Facsimile grimoire
description: A printed copy of a four-hundred-year-old spellbook, marginal notes and all.

name: A Heretic's History of the Furrow
description: A history of the Order by one of its own priestesses. Not banned, exactly.

name: Antique atlas
description: Hand-coloured maps of the Expanse from before the railways.

name: Questionable artefact
description: A small brass thing with a hinge and no obvious purpose. The label says only "opens".

name: Vintage silk scarf
description: A printed silk scarf older than you, in very good condition.

name: Old band T-shirt
description: Faded tour dates on the back, from a band that split up before you were born.

name: Worn leather jacket
description: Soft with age, mended at one elbow by someone who knew how.

name: Second-hand paperback
description: A novel with a cracked spine and someone's bus ticket for a bookmark.

name: Heartsease draught
description: A small bottle of something rose-gold you brewed yourself. It makes you easy to warm to for a day.

name: Bloom cordial
description: A sweet dark cordial of your own brewing, to be poured for two. It quiets whatever she takes against the Bloom, for a day.

effects.telling: You shared a cordial he brewed, and you know what it does: for today, what you take against the Bloom will not hold. You drank it knowing that.

name: Charmed confection
description: A box of small sweets you made and charmed at the stove. Nobody has ever been sorry to be given one.
